test.observation: All workspace tests pass: 27 launa-core, 34 launa-esp-ota, 18 hal_tests, 86 integration_tests, 30 sim_tests, 61 launa-mqtt, 14 launa-ota, 82 launa-protocol, 27 fuzz_tests, 17 property_tests, 63 launa-sim, 2 doc-tests. Total: 461+ tests pass.

typecheck.observation: Workspace compiles cleanly with no errors or warnings.

nonBlockingIssues.description: last_probe_time is unconditionally set even when client_id is None (no frame sent). Pre-existing behavior, not a regression. Practically benign since stale detection requires last_status_time to be Some.

block_on() helper duplicated identically in 3 test files (launa-hal/tests/hal_tests.rs, launa-sim/src/sim_transport.rs, launa-integration-tests/tests/sim_tests.rs). Could be extracted to a shared test utility.
app/src/transport.rs write() silently ignores flush errors with `let _ = self.uart.flush()`. Pre-existing but a log warning on flush failure would be helpful for diagnostics.

Overflow check in write() uses write_offset + chunk.len() but doesn't account for pending_bytes. In practice partitions are 1.25 MiB and firmware images are smaller, so extremely unlikely to cause overflow.
begin() resets pending_len to 0 but does not clear pending_bytes array. Functionally safe since pending_len gates reads, but explicit clearing would be more defensive.

publish_discovery() hand-rolls device_info JSON with format!() including sw_version without escape_json_string(). Low-risk since CARGO_PKG_VERSION is from Cargo.toml (controlled source). This will be addressed by the refactor-discovery-to-builder feature in milestone mqtt.

appliedUpdates.description: Fixed inaccuracy in architecture.md: 'MqttClient uses DiscoveryBuilder from launa-mqtt for HA auto-discovery' → corrected to state that publish_discovery() hand-rolls discovery configs and does NOT use DiscoveryBuilder (refactor planned for milestone 2).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Consider adding a convention note about the block_on() pattern for testing async traits: when testing async Transport methods in synchronous test contexts, workers should use the manual RawWaker + single-poll block_on() pattern. Could also suggest extracting to a shared utility.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: block_on() helper duplicated identically in 3 test files across crates (launa-hal, launa-sim, launa-integration-tests). Feature unify-transport-trait-async introduced this pattern.
